blocks.heading: BSc Physics Career Options
rows: JEST (PhD, Integrated PhD and MSc physics at research institutes)

No degree is needed to sit the test. The score is then used with each institute's own rule. A PhD in physics asks for an MSc in physics at every participating institute. Many MSc and Integrated PhD seats take a BSc in physics or a BE/BTech. JEST 2026 was held on 12 April 2026 and results came on 30 April 2026. The fee was ₹1,200 (₹600 for SC, ST and PwD).
Yes for MSc and Integrated PhD seats that accept a BSc. No for the PhD seats, which need the MSc first. JEST is recognised as a NET by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation for fellowships.
IIT JAM Physics and CUET PG

Open to BSc graduates, including final-year students. JAM Physics is the largest door into MSc seats at IITs and many other institutes, and the NISER medical physics master's also reads the JAM score. The odds and dates are worked out in the BSc guide linked above.
Yes. This is the main BSc-stage door into a funded, public MSc.
CSIR-UGC NET (Physical Sciences) for JRF and lectureship

Needs a master's degree, or the four-year degree route set out in the bulletin. The December 2026 cycle was reported open with exams in late December. The JRF age limit is reported as 30. A CSIR JRF is paid ₹37,000 a month.
Not with a plain three-year BSc. Read the current NTA bulletin for the exact marks and age rule.

An MSc in physics with Physics and Mathematics at BSc level, at least 60% aggregate in the MSc and 60% in BSc physics, or a BE/BTech in Engineering Physics. Screening is by the BARC online test or a valid GATE Physics score from 2024, 2025 or 2026. The notice says final selection is solely on interview performance. Age limit 26 for the general category on 1 August 2026. MSc Medical Physics, Chemical Physics and Geophysics are named as not eligible for this discipline.
No. It needs the MSc. A BSc graduate should plan the MSc with maths and 60% in mind.
ISRO-centre project posts (NESAC notice dated 17 July 2026)

Junior Research Fellow: first-class MSc in physics, atmospheric science or related subjects, with a valid NET or GATE. Maximum age 28 at interview. Fellowship ₹37,000 a month. Posts are temporary and co-terminus with the project, up to five years, with no provision for regularisation. The Research Scientist post asks for a first-class master's and pays ₹56,100 a month for up to three years.
No. Master's plus NET or GATE. These are project jobs, not permanent posts.
The August 2026 advertisement covered in the BSc guide asked for a BE/BTech in Electronics, Mechanical or Computer Science with at least 65%.
No. A physics degree alone does not meet the rule. See the space-science guide for the engineering route.
